gaps.sentence: The economy showed further ___ (WEAK) in the third quarter.
gaps.explanation: 'Further weakness' — the noun form follows the adjective 'further'.

gaps.sentence: She gave a very ___ (CONFUSE) explanation of the rules.
gaps.explanation: 'Confusing' describes something that causes confusion; 'confused' describes the person affected.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.

gaps.sentence: You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.
'Needs revising' = needs to be revised — need + -ing.

gaps.sentence: The committee's ___ (DECIDE) was announced this morning.
The team celebrated a quick ___ (SOLVE) to the crisis.
gaps.explanation: 'A solution to the crisis' — the noun.
